What stood out to me the most was the structured approach to teaching. The session was well-organized, with a clear focus on concepts rather than just shortcuts. The faculty explained topics in a simple and practical way, which made even difficult concepts easier to understand.

I also appreciated how interactive the class was. It didn’t feel like a one-way lecture—there was constant engagement, doubt-solving, and discussion around different problem-solving strategies. This really helped in building confidence, especially for sections like Quant and Logical Reasoning.

Overall, NightOwl Prep provides a supportive and motivating environment for serious aspirants. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for structured guidance and clarity in their CAT preparation.
